title: Wildflowers
description: One cheerful wildflower clump for a 1 m meadow cell: low green leaf tufts and blades, and eight thin stems topped by flat star flowers, two each of red, yellow, blue and white. A single mesh node `crop` (materials crop + petal + head + flower + seed), instanced.
checks: 3/4 tile: red, yellow, blue and white flower heads on thin green stems above low green leaves
TOP tile: the clump stays inside the 1 m cell; the eight flower heads are spread across it
FRONT tile: the tallest flower reaches the top of the box (0.65 m), stems start on the grid line
